name: Hotel Innsbruck
beschreibung: The prestigious Hotel Innsbruck enjoys a premier riverfront setting along the Inn, mere steps from the famous Golden Roof and the medieval Old Town. Seamlessly blending cosmopolitan elegance with authentic Tyrolean alpine character, the 4-star establishment provides stylishly appointed rooms and suites overlooking the river and the dramatic peaks of the Nordkette. Guests delight in the two-story indoor spa haven, featuring an indoor swimming pool, panoramic sauna, steam baths, and a sun deck above the city rooftops. Outstanding regional gastronomy and selected wines are served in the inviting dining parlours and chic hotel bar.
kurzbeschreibung: Upscale 4-star riverfront hotel in Innsbruck near the Old Town featuring a luxury rooftop spa.
